ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ)
ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). The hall has 12-hour and 24-hour rates; night-time or 24-hour use may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. Except for some areas, the venue can be used 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Advance receipt of packages is in principle for arrival on the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice is required (items are accepted only on the day before use). (Source: Hall price list, updated July 3, 2026; Advance Load-in Notice; FAQ)
ops.waitingRooms: The 1F Event Hall has 3 waiting rooms (40㎡, 28㎡, 35㎡; usage fee 0 yen; under the terms of use they are waiting rooms on the 2F), and the 5F conference rooms have 4 waiting rooms (14㎡, 23㎡, 17㎡, 16㎡; 19,800 to 31,900 yen for 4 hours, tax included). Waiting rooms cannot be used on their own. (Source: Official facility page, 5F conference room price list)
ops.loadingHours: Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave within the usage time. An advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). The hall has 3 load-in entrances, and 4-ton trucks can load in and out directly. At the 1F hall, the space inside the shutter is 3,850 mm high x 4,760 mm wide x 9,000 mm deep (4-ton long trucks require consultation); for the 5F conference rooms, the B2F loading area is 3,100 mm high x 6,000 mm long. Loading and unloading at the loading area is in principle limited to 15 minutes; beyond 15 minutes, a fee of 300 yen or more is charged when exiting. Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 5 boxes for the hall and 2 boxes per room. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice (Shinjuku Grand), Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 16, official facility page)
ops.parking: The building that houses the facility (Sumitomo Fudosan Shinjuku Grand Tower) has an hourly parking lot for visitors, but the number of spaces is limited. To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Shinjuku Grand" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: FAQ, official facility page)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking and roadside parking around the building outside the designated parking lot are strictly prohibited. Products, packing materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. If delivery vehicle traffic is expected to be congested, traffic staff are placed at the entrance. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice (Shinjuku Grand), Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15 and 16)
